Keep three fields: sortField, sortDir and page. Everything shown is a getter computed from them plus rows, so nothing can get out of sync.
Sort a copy: [...this.rows].sort(...). Array.prototype.sort is stable, so equal values keep their order; sorting this.rows itself would mutate the parent's data.

For names compare a.name.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.name.toLowerCase()); for amounts a.amount - b.amount. Multiply by -1 for descending. totalPages is Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length / pageSize)); the visible slice is sorted.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize).
